scope: Proposition 5.3 (One-insertion forms) of the manuscript “Scale and conformal symmetry in four-dimensional operational quantum field theory” (preprints/Scale-and-conformal-symmetry-in-four-dimensional-operational-quantum-field-theory-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 282 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 485a44682f95ef0d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are unique tempered, Hermitian, Poincaré- and scale- covariant Wightman forms with exactly one insertion L and arbitrarily many physical insertions, whose extreme vacuum values are those of l and which satisfy □L = Θ. They have the ordinary ordered spectra, are local under every allowed adjacent interchange, and depend only on the physical polynomial vectors on the two sides of L.
